title: A served coord.py wait ends when its client disconnects
goal: coord.py serve ends a long-poll wait whose client has closed the connection (checked in the poll loop beside the key recheck), so a client that gives up on a wait --timeout 1e9 does not hold a handler thread for the whole timeout. Found by the SP-fp3hxl6q review (S4): BG-ih3awckg closed the unauthenticated hold, not this one.

run:
import inspect,sys
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools')
import coord
src=inspect.getsource(coord)
ok=('MSG_PEEK' in src) or ('select.select' in src) or ('selectors' in src)
print('served wait checks its client',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
